title: Co-Create should follow UI language, not story_language: English replies with Vietnamese UI
description: Follow-up to ainovel-cli-z4g. Host.coCreateLang() prefers cfg.StoryLanguage, but /config language switch only changes cfg.Language (story_language preserved by design). User config: language=vi, story_language=en -> Co-Create replies English under Vietnamese UI. Co-Create is a UI conversation surface: priority must be cfg.Language -> cfg.StoryLanguage -> zh, plus per-language instruction to mirror the user's own message language.
close_reason: Closed

title: Co-Create replies and prompt brief stay Chinese regardless of UI language / Vietnamese prompts
description: internal/host/cocreate.go: coCreateSystemPrompt & stageCoCreateSystemPrompt hardcode Chinese output pins ('中文创作指令', '中文自然回复', Chinese draft heading examples) and never consult story_language / UI language, unlike assets.Load which appends per-language directives to writer/architect prompts. Fix: neutralize base templates, append coCreateLangDirective selected from cfg.StoryLanguage (fallback UI language, zh default) in CoCreateStream/StageCoCreateStream.
close_reason: Closed

title: Outline panel renders blank lines for books with <20 chapters: b.WriteString(line) deleted in renderOutlineList
description: internal/entry/tui/panels_outline.go:51 — during i18n refactor the 'b.WriteString(line)' statement was accidentally deleted from renderOutlineList; only b.WriteString("\n") remains. The line (marker + chapter number + title + in-progress badge) is built but never written. renderOutlineSection routes all books with fewer than outlineGridThreshold (20) chapters to this function, so the outline card shows only blank lines for the common short-novel case. Upstream ac1495e wrote the line then a newline. Fix: restore b.WriteString(line) before b.WriteString("\n").
close_reason: Restored b.WriteString(line) in renderOutlineList (internal/entry/tui/panels_outline.go). Regression test TestRenderOutlineListShowsChapterTitles asserts chapter titles + in-progress badge render.

title: TUI panic on failed /export: formatExportSuccess(nil) in error branch of exportDoneMsg
description: internal/entry/tui/model_update.go:563-573 — the exportDoneMsg handler lost its 'else if msg.result != nil' branch during the i18n refactor: the success event (formatExportSuccess) is now nested INSIDE the msg.err != nil branch. exp.Run returns (nil, err) on all error paths, so formatExportSuccess dereferences res.Chapters on a nil *exp.Result -> nil pointer panic in the TUI on any failed /export. Also, successful exports no longer emit the success event. Upstream ac1495e had: if err != nil {error} else if result != nil {success}. Fix: restore the else-if structure keeping localized strings.
close_reason: Restored the else-if structure in exportDoneMsg (internal/entry/tui/model_update.go): failure emits only the ERROR event, success emits formatExportSuccess(result). Regression tests TestExportDoneMsgFailureEmitsErrorOnly / TestExportDoneMsgSuccessEmitsSuccessEvent added in internal/entry/tui/export_test.go.

title: Investigate Vietnamese ARBITER stall
description: Trace the fork's normalization and English/Vietnamese localization changes for regressions in the original novel-generation flow, reproduce the Vietnamese prompt stall at ARBITER, identify the root cause, and implement a focused fix only if evidence supports it.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified; original flow compatibility checked; Vietnamese ARBITER path verified; focused regression coverage added when applicable.
close_reason: Root cause: startup rule normalization was synchronously required before the original plan-start ARBITER call, and shared structured execution can wait indefinitely on repeated malformed output. Made normalization failure non-blocking in TUI/headless; plan-start remains required. Verified full Go test suite.

title: Restore upstream compatibility defaults: unknown-locale zh fallback, decouple /config language switch from story_language, restore /model early-return, diag Target fields, EPUB zh-CN xml:lang, 启动裁定 label
description: Companion to the P1/P3/P4 i18n-regression beads: (1) NormalizeLanguage/DetectSystemLanguage unknown-locale fallback should be zh (upstream language) instead of vi so upstream users with LANG=C etc keep Chinese UI + Chinese story directives; vi/en are detected via their own locale prefixes. (2) /config language switch must set UI language only (ConfigureLanguage(selected, "")) because story-language directives are baked into prompts at launch; show current story language + how to change it. (3) Restore /model <unknown-role> early-return (upstream behavior). (4) Restore Target fields meta/progress.json and runtime.flow in diag rules_flow.go. (5) EPUB xml:lang zh-CN and 'Untitled' fallback title to keep zh exports byte-compatible with upstream. (6) zh label tui.decision.plan_start back to 启动裁定 (log-grep compat) + revert engine_test expectation. (7) Restore pausing vs paused distinction via new tui.status.pausing key. (8) Fix inProgressDisplay trailing '第 N 章: ' colon glitch.
close_reason: All compat restorations applied: DefaultLanguage/NormalizeLanguage unknown-locale fallback changed vi->zh (upstream language; vi/en still auto-detected via their locale prefixes); /config language switch now sets UI language only (ConfigureLanguage(selected, "")) with story-language shown as menu hint and kept in the switched message; /model unknown-role early-return restored; diag Target fields meta/progress.json + runtime.flow restored; EPUB xml:lang uses epubLanguageTag() (zh-CN for zh) and untitled fallback restored to literal Untitled; zh tui.decision.plan_start restored to 启动裁定; pausing/paused labels split again (tui.status.pausing); inProgressDisplay now uses tui.status.chapter_num (no trailing colon). Full go test ./... passes.

title: Missing locale keys: tui.phase.premise and tui.flow.steering show raw English in sidebar (zh regression vs upstream)
description: Upstream panels_sidebar.go hardcoded premise->前提 and steering->干预 in snapshotPhaseLabel/snapshotFlowLabel. The fork replaced them with i18n lookups (tui.phase.<phase> / tui.flow.<flow>) but never added premise/steering keys to internal/i18n/locales/{zh,en,vi}.json. Result: in ALL languages, including zh, the sidebar/report shows raw 'premise'/'steering' where upstream zh showed 前提/干预. Add the keys to all three locale files (phases present: init, brainstorm, outline, characters, writing, review, complete; flows present: idle, writing, reviewing, rewriting, polishing, planning).
close_reason: Added tui.phase.premise (前提/Premise/Tiền đề) and tui.flow.steering (干预/Steering/Can thiệp) to all three locales. TestSnapshotPhaseFlowLabelsCoverDomainValues iterates domain phase/flow enums across all languages; TestLocaleFileParity enforces key-set + verb parity.

title: diag.rules.chronic_low_dimension.sugg placeholder mismatch: zh has 2 %s, en/vi have 1
description: internal/diag/rules_quality.go:46 passes two args (name, name) to i18n.T('diag.rules.chronic_low_dimension.sugg'). zh template consumes both %s; en and vi templates contain only one %s so the second argument is silently dropped — en/vi users lose the second dimension mention in the suggestion text. No crash (Go fmt ignores extra args). Align en/vi templates to include both %s placeholders.
close_reason: en/vi chronic_low_dimension.sugg templates now carry both %s placeholders. TestLocaleFileParity asserts per-key fmt-verb sequence parity across locales (%% handled as literal) so this drift class is caught at test time.
